title: clinopodium atlanticum
intro: Clinopodium atlanticum, commonly known as Atlantic Clinopodium or Wild Basil, is a plant species within the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Mediterranean region, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium atlanticum include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
